claim_boundary: Static one-to-one source-mesh-to-builder mapping for the reconstruction manifest's 24 storage and 10 service project-authored parts. It proves only static editable source coverage; it does not run CadQuery, export FCStd/STEP, alter the reconstruction-manifest pending status, prove manufacturing, materials, sealing, pressure, electrical ratings, mass properties, or runtime acceptance.
source_mesh_mapping_rule: Each manifest_part_id, source_mesh, and builder_symbol is unique and must exactly match the pending reconstruction manifest's storage/service set.

dry_compartment.mass_increment_interface: cardboard/PP/PET/aluminum resident rigid-body load transfers through dry-bin contact; aggregate mode is mutually exclusive and bounded 0_to_1.512 kg
dry_compartment.load_constraints: Capacity, drop load, CoG and structural validation remain blocked.

wet_compartment.mass_increment_interface: Recovered standing water must increment wastewater payload through the existing dynamic-payload/water-recovery interface.
wet_compartment.load_constraints: Leak, pressure, chemical compatibility, tank mass/CoG and runtime recovery remain blocked.

service_assembly_semantics.rule: Each service feature is separately mapped; one fused box is forbidden.
